info.name: StreamButed - Full Flow Integration
info.description: Functional end-to-end flows for StreamButed through the local gateway. Requires reproducible verified seed users, especially an ARTIST account.

item.name: 0. Preconditions
item.description: Fast fail if the gateway or required services are unavailable.

item.name: 1. Authentication With Seed Users

exec: pm.test('seed artist credentials are configured', function () { pm.expect(hasSeed, 'Set seedArtistEmail and seedArtistPassword in the Postman environment').to.eql(true); });
pm.test('seed user is ARTIST', function () { pm.expect(String(json.role || '').toUpperCase()).to.eql('ARTIST'); });
pm.test('validated token has subject', function () { pm.expect(json.subject || json.userId || json.sub).to.exist; });
pm.test('profile role is ARTIST', function () { pm.expect(String(json.role || '').toUpperCase()).to.eql('ARTIST'); });
pm.test('admin seed not configured, optional admin flow skipped', function () { pm.expect(hasSeed).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('admin token already configured, optional login skipped', function () { pm.expect(pm.environment.get('adminAccessToken')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('seed user is ADMIN', function () { pm.expect(String(json.role || '').toUpperCase()).to.eql('ADMIN'); });
pm.test('listener seed not configured, optional flow skipped', function () { pm.expect(hasSeed).to.eql(false); });

item.description: Uses a verified ARTIST seed because email verification codes are not available deterministically to Newman.

item.name: 2. Media Functional Flow
Media - Upload Without JWT Is Rejected

item.description: Uploads small deterministic fixtures and stores asset IDs for Catalog.

item.name: 3. Catalog Functional Flow

exec: pm.test('status 201 expected for album creation', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('status 201 expected for track creation', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('search returns arrays', function () { pm.expect(json.artists).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.albums).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.tracks).to.be.an('array'); });

item.description: Strict Catalog assertions: current 500s should fail here until migrations/schema are fixed.

item.name: 4. Playback And Streaming Functional Flow
Playback - Stream Without JWT Is Rejected

exec: pm.test('skipped because no created or seed track is available', function () { pm.expect(hasTrack).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('stream session includes track and URL', function () { pm.expect(json.trackId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('playbackTrackId')); pm.expect(json.streamUrl).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('latest progress has numeric position', function () { pm.expect(json.positionSeconds).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('skipped because playback token is unavailable', function () { pm.expect(hasPlaybackToken).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('stream has byte range headers', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Range') || '').to.match(/^bytes /); });

item.description: Uses the track created by Catalog or seedTrackId if provided.

item.name: 5. Library Functional Flow

exec: pm.test('library has likedSongs and playlists', function () { pm.expect(json.likedSongs).to.be.an('object'); pm.expect(json.playlists).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('skipped because no created or seed track is available', function () { pm.expect(hasTrack).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('skipped because playlist or playable track is unavailable', function () { pm.expect(hasTrack && hasPlaylist).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('playlist contains at least one track', function () { pm.expect(json.trackCount).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(json.tracks).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('playlist response remains valid', function () { pm.expect(json.playlistId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('playlistId')); pm.expect(json.tracks).to.be.an('array'); });

item.description: Exercises library summary, likes and private playlists with a valid JWT.

item.name: 6. Analytics Functional Flow
Analytics - Admin Summary With Artist Is Forbidden

exec: pm.test('admin token not configured, optional admin summary skipped', function () { pm.expect(hasAdminToken).to.eql(false); });

item.description: Admin success is optional and requires adminAccessToken or an admin seed flow outside this collection.

item.name: 7. Live Functional Flow
Live - Rooms Without JWT Is Rejected

exec: pm.test('live room created or active room returned', function () { pm.expect(json.id).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(json.title).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('rooms response has data', function () { pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.total).to.be.a('number'); });
pm.test('skipped because live room was not created in this run', function () { pm.expect(hasRoom).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('listener token not configured, optional listener live flow skipped', function () { pm.expect(hasListenerToken).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('listener can list live rooms', function () { pm.expect(json.data).to.be.an('array'); });

item.description: REST live room flow. WebRTC/Socket.IO signalling is intentionally out of scope for Postman.

item.name: 8. Cleanup

exec: pm.test('logout body is empty', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.eql(''); });

item.description: Invalidates the artist refresh cookie at the end of the run.
